title: Democratic Commands
description: Adds a screen where players can enter commands to be executed if everyone entered the same command
body:
# Democratic Commands

**A mod that aims to allow players to have control spread out instead of having an operator.**

How to use the mod:
1. Press the "#" key to open the democratic interface
2. Enter the command you want to be executed
3. Press "Confirm" to submit your command
4. If everyone has entered the same command, it will be executed

I’m open to suggestions or requests — feel free to reach out if you have a mod idea.

If there are any issues with the mod, please contact me at ItalianChef123@hotmail.com or on discord at italianchef123
